title: TAI owner activation dispatch bridge
objective: Replace unreliable multi-event activation runs with a separate owner-only command workflow that verifies the completed exact-main owner preflight and dispatches the production activation workflow with exact inputs; keep activation and downstream deployment as independent auditable workflow runs.
boundaries: Only /tai activate current-main on issue 3365 by the repository owner can dispatch activation
The command workflow requires the latest completed successful exact-SHA owner-preflight run and all six successful jobs
The activation workflow accepts only workflow_dispatch with exact confirmation and re-verifies the same preflight run, owner actors and six jobs
The activation workflow no longer listens to issue_comment or workflow_run events
Image, protected REG.RU controller, RU/EN/ZH SSE, Chromium, finalization, rollback and standalone deployment gates remain unchanged
